pages.title: Lower Mainland
pages.description: single entity of population of British Columbia, Canada
pages.extract:
The Lower Mainland is in British Columbia, Canada. The official tourist information site calls the area "Vancouver,  Coast and Mountains".
The term "lower mainland" has different meanings; for some people it is equivalent to "Greater Vancouver", while others include everything out to Abbotsford or Hope in the east, and Squamish or Whistler in the north. Here we use it to describe the area from Vancouver in the west to Hope in the east, and from the American border in the south, to the town of Whistler and the Sunshine Coast in the north.

pages.title: San Cipriano
pages.description: small village in Valle del Cauca Department, Colombia
pages.extract:
San Cipriano is tiny town of 500 inhabitants close to Buenaventura in western Colombia. The town is in a humid subtropical forest, and therefore the weather is characterized by frequent rain and humid, warm daytime temperatures. Ethnically, the town is almost 100% composed of Colombians of African descent. Regarding the flora and fauna, the area is characterized by species native the region: toucans and subtropical birds, snakes, monkeys, and several wild species of mammals.
Getting there is half the fun, but the beautiful surroundings and tranquil vibe of the area can keep you busy for a day or two.

pages.title: South Yorkshire
pages.description: county of England, UK
pages.extract:
South Yorkshire is the southern county of Yorkshire in the north of England. Much of it is industrial, but its western reaches in the Pennine hills have lonely moorlands and scenic valleys.
South Yorkshire marks the beginning of "The North" - neighbouring areas just south are in the Midlands. It's nowadays a county in name only, as it's divided into four "unitary" or metropolitan districts, with no county level of government. It's convenient here to consider it in terms of those four, as visitor amenities cluster and transport routes radiate accordingly.

pages.title: Herne
pages.description: town in Arnsberg Government Region, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
pages.extract: Herne is a city of 156,000 people (2019) in the Ruhr area. Part of the city escaped the extensive bombing that destroyed other Rugr cities in World War II, so there are still many historical buildings, especially in the Herne-Mitte district, many of them from the Wilhelminian era.

pages.title: Nuevo Nayarit
pages.description: town in Bahía de Banderas Municipality, State of Nayarit, Mexico
pages.extract: Nuevo Nayarit, for a long time named Nuevo Vallarta and colloquially referred to as Nuevo, is a resort community in Nayarit on the Pacific Coast of Mexico, immediately north of Puerto Vallarta. The community is home to luxury villas and canals lined with tropical gardens, along over 18 km (11 mi) of white sandy beach.

pages.extract: Cardona  is a town in the province of Rizal, Philippines. At the boundary between the urban conurbation extending from Metro Manila and eastern Rizal, it is a fishing and agriculture-oriented town where rural Rizal is said to begin.

pages.title: Rizal (disambiguation)
pages.extract:
There is more than one place called Rizal:

 José Rizal. José Rizal (1861-1896) was an important writer and one of the main heroes of Filipino resistance against Spanish rule. In addition to the places mentioned below, the country is full of things named for him. Many towns have one or more of Rizal Street. Rizal Park or Rizal Barangay, there are several universities, and statues are fairly common. 
Wikipedia has long lists of such places, including quite a few outside the Philippines. Here we list only the ones for which Wikivoyage has information.
